newsitem.title: USA: BOXING-MARQUEZ STOPS ELLIS TO RETAIN IBF JR MIDDLEWEIGHT TITLE.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-MARQUEZ STOPS ELLIS TO RETAIN IBF JR MIDDLEWEIGHT TITLE.

text.p: LAKE CHARLES, Louisiana, July 6 (Ruter) - Undefeated Raul Marquez easily defended his International Boxing Federation junior middleweight title when he stopped Romallis Ellis in the fourth round on Saturday.
Marquez, making the first defence of the IBF belt he won by stopping Anthony Stephens last April, improved to 27-0.
Ellis, a bronze medallist for the United States in the 1988 Olympic Games, fell to 24-2.
Marquez dropped Ellis with a straight left hand with 35 seconds remaining in the second round but Ellis weathered the storm until the fourth round.
The Mexican proved to be too strong for Ellis, a late replacement for Argentine Ernesto Rafael Sena.
Marquez sent Ellis to the canvas for the second time in the fight early in the fourth round but it was ruled a slip by referee Elmo Adolph.

Ellis appeared to be hurt as Marquez went on the offensive, landing a barrage of unanswered punches. Adolph then stepped in to rescue the defenceless Ellis, halting the contest 74 seconds into the round.
